subject: Evidence request: SCIM / SAML / RBAC details for SIG / SOC 2
messages:
From: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com, security@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM / SAML / RBAC details for SIG / SOC 2

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — ClearLine's security team needs to validate a few controls for our SIG/SOC 2 intake. Could you share the following artifacts so we can progress procurement? We're under a tight deadline (need to hand the package to our auditor next Friday).

Requested items (high level):
- SCIM delta sample showing user create/update/delete events for a 30-day window (CSV or similar)
- SAML assertion samples (including NameID and attribute mappings)
- Role/permission matrix that shows least-privilege mappings for typical product roles
- Confirmation of whether SSO/JIT provisioning is enabled for service accounts and any exceptions
- Point of contact + expected delivery date

If there are controls that require a short narrative (how we enforce role approvals, delegated admin policy, etc.), a one-paragraph description per control is fine.

Amanda Torres
Security Program Manager — ClearLine Health
amanda.torres@clearlinehealth.com


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Amanda — appreciate the clear list. We're able to produce everything you asked for.

Quick plan:
- I'll own package coordination and delivery.
- Irene will export SAML assertion examples and provide the attribute mapping narrative.
- Marcus will pull a SCIM delta sample (30-day range) and add a brief note about retention/rotation.
- Aditya will scrub and finalize the least-privilege role matrix and add approvals flow description.

I've attached a short workback timeline outlining when each artifact will be available. Proposed delivery: all artifacts by Friday, Jun 20 COB PT. If you need anything sooner (or a partial handoff), let me know and we'll prioritize the SAML + SCIM exports first.

Attachments: workback_timeline_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: stephanie@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: SCIM / SAML / RBAC details for SIG / SOC 2

Team — forwarding ClearLine's ask (see Amanda's note below). Please treat this as high priority; procurement flagged a firm auditor handoff next Friday. Action items:

1) Irene: SAML assertion examples + attribute mapping narrative (one paragraph). Include example NameID formats we emit, and the default attribute set for provisioning. Mark any attributes that are customer-controlled vs. system-provided.
2) Marcus: SCIM delta sample — CSV with user_id, action (create/update/delete), timestamp, source. Please pick a recent 30-day window (prefer Jun 1–30) and scrub any PII. Add a 2–3 sentence note about retention and how delta exports are generated (endpoint and retention policy).
3) Aditya: Least-privilege matrix — map product roles (viewer, analyst, app-admin, infra-admin, service-account) to permissions, and include who can approve role changes. Add a short description of the delegated admin process and escalation steps.

Constraints: we should avoid sending live PII. Use synthetic or redacted values in the SCIM sample. Keep each artifact self-contained (narrative + sample).

Delivery plan: consolidate artifacts into a single ZIP and upload to the drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2-example-workback. I will handle external delivery and light redaction as needed. Please:
- Target internal drop by Thu Jun 19 EOD PT so I can run a quick review.
- Name files with the pattern: <company>_<artifact>_v1 (e.g., clearline_scim_delta_v1.csv)

Thanks — feel free to ping me in Slack if anything blocks.

— Stephanie


From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: SCIM / SAML / RBAC details for SIG / SOC 2

Stephanie / team — attaching the SAML assertion examples and a short attribute mapping note. Two quick points:

- NameID format: we support both transient and persistent. Example below shows persistent NameID for enterprise SSO.
- We include the following attributes by default: email, given_name, family_name, groups, role; customers can add optional attributes via SCIM mapping.

Attachments: saml_assertions_example.txt

I'll drop the sample into the shared drive in the folder Stephanie created.

Irene Choi
Identity & Access Engineer
irene@redwoodinference.com

Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM / SAML / RBAC details for SIG / SOC 2 — artifact delivery

Amanda — thanks for the clear list; we're handing over the package as discussed. Below is a summary and links to artifacts. If you'd like a short (15m) walkthrough of any piece, we can schedule early next week.

Delivered artifacts (zipped): clearline_evidence_package_v1.zip
Contents: 
- clearline_scim_delta_v1.csv (sample: user_id, action, timestamp, source)
- saml_assertions_example.txt (sample assertions + attribute mapping note)
- least_privilege_matrix_v2.xlsx (role -> permission mapping + approval owners)
- workback_timeline_v1.pdf (internal timeline / delivery notes)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2-example-workback (folder access granted to security@clearlinehealth.com)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/CL-5682 (attached package in Files)

Notes / clarifications:
- SCIM export: redacted sample contains synthetic identifiers; our API endpoint for SCIM deltas is documented at /docs/provisioning#scim-deltas. Retention for delta exports is 90 days before rolling archiving; longer-term logs are available via enterprise audit export (request via support).
- SAML: we support persistent and transient NameIDs. Attribute mapping is customer-configurable; default attributes emitted are email, given_name, family_name, groups, role.
- Least-privilege: matrix ties product roles to permissions; role changes require ticket + manager approval, and infra-admin role requires a second approver.

Attachments delivered: scim_delta_sample.csv, saml_assertions_example.txt, least_privilege_matrix_v2.xlsx, workback_timeline_v1.pdf

Next steps: let us know if the auditor needs anything different or a signed attestation. If you need a prioritized short-hand package (SAML + SCIM only) by Thursday morning, we can do that.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
